candidates.name: AfriSenti
candidates.notes: Sentiment labels for 14 African languages (110k tweets). 3-class label targets.

candidates.name: AfriXNLI

candidates.name: AfriQA
candidates.notes: Cross-lingual open-retrieval QA over 10 African languages with English questions and native-language answers.

candidates.name: AfriQA Gold Passages
candidates.notes: Gold evidence passages for AfriQA; supplies the context field for WSTU samples.

candidates.name: MAFAND-MT
candidates.notes: News translation data across 21 African languages, human-translated by speakers.

candidates.name: AfriMGSM
candidates.notes: GSM8K professionally translated into African languages with native-speaker verification. Dedup vs openai/gsm8k.

candidates.name: Uhura ARC-Easy
candidates.notes: ARC-Easy translated/built for African languages as part of select-and-translate eval sets. Benchmark => evaluation_only.

candidates.name: AfriMMLU
